user.title: Poltergeist
user.description: Estimate where people are in the house from motion sensors that are assigned to areas. Nothing needs to be configured here.

init.title: Poltergeist
init.description: How many people a room can hold before the top count means "this many or more". A single motion sensor cannot tell these counts apart; a higher value only matters once sensors that count people are added. Changing it reloads the integration.
